name: Large Spider
appearance: A two-foot-wide web-spinner with a bulbous abdomen and slender legs.

Special attacks.name: Sticky web
Special attacks.effectNote: Strength 19 or higher leaves a creature unaffected. A creature below Strength 19 needs one round to break free for each point below 19. An entangled creature loses its Dexterity adjustment to Armor Class, and attacks against it gain a +4 bonus. Nearby Large Spiders attack it while it is stuck.

Special attacks.name: Type A poison
Special attacks.effectNote: The bite poison takes effect after 15 minutes. It deals 15 damage on a failed save vs. poison. The victim gets +2 on the save, and success negates the poison damage.

notes: 2–20 appearing. The table lists swarm organization.
Common. Carnivore. Nonintelligent (0). Neutral. Unsteady (7) morale. Treasure J–N.
The entry gives no fixed hit points. Special defenses and magic resistance are listed as Nil.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), p. 326.

name: Huge Spider
appearance: A six-foot-wide hunting spider with a proportionally larger head, large fangs, and hairy body and legs.

Special attacks.name: Leaping ambush
Special attacks.effectNote: From camouflaged tunnels or holes, the spider can leap up to 30 feet at an unsuspecting victim. Opponents take a −6 penalty on surprise rolls when it attacks this way.

Special attacks.name: Type A poison
Special attacks.effectNote: The bite poison takes effect after 15 minutes. It deals 15 damage on a failed save vs. poison. The victim gets +1 on the save, and success negates the poison damage.

notes: 1–12 appearing. The table lists pack organization.
Common. Carnivore. Animal intelligence (1). Neutral. Average (8) morale. Treasure J–N, Q.
The entry gives no fixed hit points. Special defenses and magic resistance are listed as Nil.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), p. 326.

name: Giant Spider
appearance: An eight- to twelve-foot-wide web-spinner with a bulbous abdomen and slender legs.

Special attacks.name: Type F poison
Special attacks.effectNote: A victim that fails its save vs. poison dies immediately.

notes: 1–8 appearing. The table lists nest organization.
Uncommon. Carnivore. Low intelligence (5–7). Chaotic evil. Elite (13) morale. Treasure C.
The entry gives no fixed hit points. Special defenses and magic resistance are listed as Nil.
The Giant column gives two base Hit Dice options. The printed THAC0 and XP values are paired with their corresponding Hit Dice.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), p. 326.
